parameters.label: CHOP
parameters.name: chop
parameters.description: The  CHOP  to be used to retrieve values. A row is created for each channel's value.

parameters.label: Include Names
parameters.name: names
parameters.description: When checked on, an extra column will be created in every row for the channel's name.

parameters.label: Latest Sample when  Time Slice
parameters.name: latestsample
parameters.description: When on and the  CHOP  is time sliced, only the latest sample of the  CHOP  will be used to create the  DAT  output. This prevents the table size from fluctuating as frames are dropped.

parameters.label: Output
parameters.name: output
parameters.description: ⊞  - Create a row per channel or column per channel.

parameters.label: Language
parameters.name: language
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select how the  DAT  decides which script language to operate on.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs script language.

parameters.label: Node
parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses it's own script language.

parameters.label: Edit/View Extension

parameters.description: ⊞  - Select the file extension this  DAT  should expose to external editors.
